title: PVA TePla
summary: German maker of vacuum furnaces, plasma systems and crystal-growing equipment.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

PVA TePla builds vacuum furnaces, plasma treatment systems and crystal-growth equipment for semiconductor, industrial and medical customers. Its systems are used in silicon carbide crystal growth, wafer processing and materials analysis. The company benefits from compound-semiconductor capacity additions.

Technology Exposure

  • Crystal-growth furnaces
  • Plasma and vacuum systems
  • Metrology and analysis equipment

What To Watch

  • SiC capacity additions
  • Industrial demand
  • Order timing

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
